programme.desc: The Beyblade World Championship Finals are underway and eight teams convene to compete for the title. The BladeBreakers are shocked to see that their old friend Zeo is in the competition and Tyson confronts him to find out why he has decided to compete against them. It turns out that Zeo is the son of Zagart, an old colleague of Mr. Dickenson's who stole the ancient rock that contained captured Bit Beasts. Zagart has already made it known to the BladeBreakers that he wants their Bit Beasts and he's going to use Zeo to get them. Once the competition begins, Zeo's team member Gordo makes short work of Dunga. Then it's Zeo turn. He goes up against Ozuma and it is clear to everyone watching that Zeo's Blade is no ordinary Beyblade. After a very intense battle Zeo defeats Ozuma surprising the entire audience and putting him in a position to move on to the next round where his team will battle the BladeBreakers!!

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd: Pronounced Leh-Nerd Skin-Nerd & Second Helping - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd and Second Helping, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida.

programme.title: Motörhead - Rock Im Park
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days; featuring: Motörhead.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Linkin Park - Live in New York
programme.desc: Filmed at the Madison Square Garden in New York, this concert film gives all fans a spectacular live experience from start to finish; Linkin Park performs hits including "Numb," "In the End," "Bleed It Out" and many more.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Nice Jazz Festival 2012
programme.desc: Watch the famous jazz singer, Gregory Porter, perform at Nice Jazz Festival 2012.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - A Musicares Tribute
programme.desc: The unmistakable Paul McCartney was honored as Person of the Year by MusiCares at a gala event that brought together several artists to celebrate the Beatles' victorious career.

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Seal's one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. He's delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career.

programme.title: Michael Kiwanuka: Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: Watch Michael Kiwanuka's performance at the Garorock Festival in 2017.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: The hits from Duets II are beautifully recorded on the videos of studio recordings, Duets II - The Great Performances. Starring Andrea Bocelli, Michael Bublé, Natalie Cole, Sheryl Crow, Aretha Franklin, Josh Groban, Faith Hill, Norah Jones, and more.

programme.title: Of Monsters and Men - Main Square Festival 2013
programme.desc: The Icelandic band Of Monsters and Men perform a fun and entertaining set in sunny Arras, France. The folk story-tellers hit all the right notes!

programme.title: One Direction: Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: One Direction performs a stellar set at the 2015 edition of the Apple Music Festival. Be prepared to sing along to their catchy chart-topping hits!

programme.title: Hans Zimmer - Live in Prague
programme.desc: This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr.

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux
programme.desc: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux and this concert from 2013 is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies through their eighties blockbuster period and up to their most recent release. Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd: Pronounced Leh-Nerd Skin-Nerd & Second Helping - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd and Second Helping, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Peter Frampton - FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album Frampton Comes Alive!.

programme.title: Journey - Live in Manila
programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

programme.title: The Black Keys: Live at Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Black Keys, an American rock duo, perform their top tracks at the Austin City Limits Music Festival.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Justin Bieber - Live at Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: The film follows the pop star Justin Bieber during 10 days counting down to his performance at Madison Square Garden.

programme.title: Hall & Oates - Live at The Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: Daryl Hall and John Oates wisely reunited a few years ago after a string of solo projects, & they put on the kind of show that makes it hard to believe they even considered going their separate ways. Here they are at the Sydney Entertainment Centre.

programme.title: Lana Del Rey - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Born to Die is the second album by singer-songwriter Lana Del Rey, and the first to be officially released on January 27, 2012 and that would lead to global success; In countries such as the United Kingdom the album was the best selling of that year.

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: Lenny Kravitz has been consolidated as one of the stars that has been in force for a long time, this has led him to appear all over the world and be part of the most popular festivals in the world.

programme.title: Panic! At the Disco - Rock Am Ring 2016
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days. Featuring: Panic! At the Disco.

programme.title: Jack White - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Muse: Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring in Nürburgring and Rock Im Park in Nuremberg are music festivals that take place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in Western Germany, featuring Muse.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - The Space Within US
programme.desc: Paul McCartney presents this special performance of the US Tour, made in the United States, 11 weeks and 34 shows, playing great compositions of his solo career along with some Wings and Beatles songs.

programme.title: Nazareth - Homecoming: The Greatest Hits Live from Glasgow
programme.desc: Recorded Live at The Garage, Glasgow, in 2001, this intimate performance includes most of the band's classics such as 'Razamanaz', and 'Hair of The Dog', and more recent songs including 'When the Light Comes Down' from their album Boogaloo.

programme.title: 3 Excavators Loading Overburden + Cat 160H Grader in Huge Mine
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we’re at the heart of a massive open-pit mining operation, where three powerful excavators and a Caterpillar 160H grader are working together with amazing precision and coordination to move overburden and prepare the site for the next phase of production.

programme.title: Relocating The Caterpillar D9T Dozer, Liebherr 974 & Liebherr 954
programme.desc: In today’s heavy haul video, we follow a full relocation operation, transporting three massive machines from one job site to the next nearby project using a heavy-duty trailer and a MAN TGX 530 special transport truck.

programme.title: Mining Site Full Of Caterpillar & Liebherr Excavators And Fleet Of Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s video, we are inside a busy coal mining site, watching a non-stop operation where multiple excavators load coal and overburden onto a fleet of 4-axle trucks.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Cat 777F Dumpers With Aggregates
programme.desc: In today’s video, we’re inside a huge aggregate quarry, watching an impressive, high-production operation where a Caterpillar 992K wheel loader loads blasted material onto Caterpillar 777F dumpers with speed, precision, and nonstop rhythm.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Giant Cat 5090B Front Shovel Excavator Loading Gravel On Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, capturing the raw power and precision of the Caterpillar 5090B Front Shovel Excavator. This giant machine is seen loading gravel from a deposit area onto a fleet of 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks, preparing materials for ongoing operations across the mine.

programme.title: Liebherr 984 Excavator Loading Caterpillar 777 Dumpers Drone View
programme.desc: At the heart of today’s footage is the giant Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator, operating at full production. From the air, the true scale of this machine becomes clear as it loads blasted material with smooth, powerful cycles.

programme.title: Extreme 4K Highway Construction Full Of Heavy Equipment In Action!
programme.desc: In today’s construction video, we are on a huge highway construction site, packed with Caterpillar and Liebherr excavators, a Cat motor grader, a bulldozer, and a fleet of 4-axle trucks—all working together in a fast-moving, high-productivity operation.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Descent Into the Maelstrom
programme.desc: In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.

programme.title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

programme.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programme.title: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Fifth Symphony; Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt's First Piano Concerto.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
The Morricone Duel
programme.desc: A live concert production offers a mixture of the Wild West with the soulful sound of Italy.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

programme.title: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programme.desc: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programme.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: In this August 2020 concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra; Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: La Bayadere
programme.desc: The Paris Opera Ballet performs the work choreographed by Rudolf Nureyev.

programme.title: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart -- Quintet for Piano and Winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Berlioz
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev Conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the development of music TV over the last 50 years and its power in popularizing the classical genre.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

programme.title: Hanson: Underneath Experience Tour – Night 1 (Acoustic)
programme.desc: Hanson opens their two-night Underneath Experience Tour with an intimate acoustic performance at The Belasco in Los Angeles, celebrating the 20th anniversary of their landmark 2004 album Underneath. The set blends reimagined hits and deep cuts including “Strong Enough to Break,” “Stories,” and “When You’re Gone,” along with early fan favorites like “A Song to Sing.” Between harmonies and heartfelt stories, the brothers reflect on the album’s creation, early tours, and their enduring connection with fans.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this introspective episode, Ricky Hil — rapper, designer, and son of fashion icon Tommy Hilfiger — opens up to Joel Madden about his lifelong connection to music and streetwear, his battles with addiction, and his journey toward self-understanding. Ricky reflects on his creative independence, the lessons learned from his father, and finding peace through art after years of struggle. The conversation dives deep into authenticity, identity, and the healing power of creativity.

programme.title: Coheed and Cambria: Live at Starland Ballroom
programme.desc: Coheed and Cambria performs live at Starland Ballroom, delivering standout tracks from their first two albums in a high-energy hometown concert.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Travie McCoy discusses his gradual rise in music, from humble beginnings to headlining. He shares a metaphor from his album cover and tells a story about breaking his neck riding a dirt bike.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Los Angeles rapper Lefty Gunplay joins Joel Madden for an honest conversation about manifestation, growth, and self-belief. Lefty reflects on overcoming incarceration, finding purpose through music, and representing L.A.’s Mexican community with authenticity and pride. A grounded and motivational dialogue about humility, mindset, and the discipline it takes to turn struggle into success.

programme.title: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses perform a co-headlining concert live from The Wiltern in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: De'Wayne discusses identity and growth with Joel, touching on Lenny Kravitz, arenas, and the garage.

programme.title: Mt. Joy: Live from Red Rocks Night 1
programme.desc: Mt. Joy kicks off the first of two sold-out nights at the legendary Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado. Captured live by Veeps, the set blends fan-favorite hits and new unreleased tracks in a high-energy performance that showcases the band’s signature mix of soaring vocals and indie-rock warmth. Highlights include “Lemon Tree,” “Highway Queen,” and a special collaboration on “Lake Missoula” featuring Richy Mitch & The Coal Miners. A powerful opening night that sets the tone for a weekend of unforgettable music under the stars.

programme.title: First Listen: Motel Du Cap – Live with Good Charlotte
programme.desc: Hear Good Charlotte's new album in full with exclusive stories, commentary, and fan Q&A. Your front-row seat to Motel Du Cap.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum rapper/producer G-Eazy sits down with Joel Madden to talk brotherhood, the early grind, and returning to the road after a six-year hiatus. From funny tangents (the philosophy of milkshakes) to reflective moments about not fitting in growing up, finding belonging in music, and dedicating part of his show to his late mom, Gerald shares why performing completes the art—and how a whirlwind London stop let him share the stage with his brother James. He also recalls his first runs back (including arena-scale crowds in India) and the community that’s formed around his all-black stage persona.

programme.title: Flogging Molly: Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Flogging Molly performs a St. Patrick’s Day celebration live from Las Vegas with a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Country-rock singer-songwriter HARDY joins Joel Madden to talk about bridging the worlds of rock and country, evolving from songwriter to artist, and why connecting with fans matters most. They swap stories about small-town roots, creative identity, and finding value in authenticity over fame.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji Madden and Avenged Sevenfold’s M. Shadows reflect on 25 years of friendship and creativity in a candid conversation with Artist Friendly.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 1 – Acoustic Duo with Matt Nasir
programme.desc: The opening night of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim features an intimate acoustic set from Frank Turner and Matt Nasir. The performance blends heartfelt storytelling with stripped-down versions of fan favorites, including “Be More Kind,” “The Way I Tend to Be,” and a moving duet with KT Tunstall. Turner connects deeply with the audience while revisiting early songs and debuting new arrangements in this special evening of community, humor, and reflection.

programme.title: Macklemore – The BEN Tour: Live from Hollywood
programme.desc: GRAMMY® Award-winning rapper Macklemore brings The BEN Tour to a powerful close live from the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles, California. Blending his signature anthems like “Thrift Shop” and “Same Love” with new music from BEN, Macklemore celebrates authenticity, resilience, and community in an emotional finale filled with gratitude, energy, and connection.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel speaks with Bebe Rexha about her start in music, self-regulation, mental health, and her album Dirty Blonde.

programme.title: Jessi Cruickshank: Minivan Money
programme.desc: Comedian and TV host Jessi Cruickshank takes the stage in Toronto for her first stand-up special, Minivan Money. Known as “the funniest woman on television” (The Province), Cruickshank dives into the chaos of motherhood with biting honesty and fearless humor. From pumping breastmilk onstage to lusting after preschool dads, she turns the absurd realities of parenting into sharp, self-aware comedy. Blending storytelling, satire, and confessional wit, this live performance captures a comedian in full command of her craft — raw, real, and hilariously relatable.

programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Country artist Dylan Schneider joins Joel Madden to discuss his rise from Indiana to Nashville, his new EP Bad Decisions, and the heartfelt inspiration behind Daddy Drinks Whiskey. Schneider opens up about his songwriting roots, working with Florida Georgia Line, and his journey through the evolving landscape of modern country music.

programme.title: Oasis: Familiar to Millions
programme.desc: Oasis performs live at Wembley Stadium in 2000, delivering hits like Wonderwall and Live Forever in a massive concert event.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Singer-songwriter Jax joins Joel Madden for an honest, funny, and emotional conversation about her deep love of emo music, growing up performing in bands, navigating online comments, and building a creative life on her own terms. From her early days opening for Good Charlotte to finding her authentic voice, Jax opens up about confidence, empathy, and artistic growth.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now - All Access Watch Party
programme.desc: GHOST’s debut film RITE HERE RITE NOW blends live performance with a narrative story. Filmed at Los Angeles' Kia Forum during the RE-IMPERATOUR tour finale.

programme.title: ODESZA: The Last Goodbye Finale Live from The Gorge
programme.desc: Filmed during the sold-out final night of ODESZA’s The Last Goodbye Tour at the legendary Gorge Amphitheatre in Washington, this breathtaking performance blends cinematic visuals, live percussion, and emotional electronic soundscapes. The finale includes two encore songs from the July 5 performance, creating an unforgettable experience from one of electronic music’s most visionary acts.

programme.title: Salad Days: A Decade Of Punk In Washington, DC (1980-1990)
programme.desc: Acclaimed documentary on punk rock's rise in DC. Bands like Bad Brains booked their own shows. Predated the 90s alternative explosion.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with 6LACK. Born in Baltimore and raised in Atlanta, 6LACK grew up around music from the start - his father owned a recording studio, and he was already stepping into the booth by age four. After cutting his teeth as a teenage battle rapper, he broke through in 2016 with his debut album Free 6lack, which spawned the Grammy-nominated single "PRBLMS" and established the introspective, emotionally direct sound he's known for. His follow-up, East Atlanta Love Letter, debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, and his most recent album, Since I Have a Lover, earned him a Grammy nomination for Best Progressive R&B Album. Along the way, he's collaborated with everyone from J. Cole and Lil Baby to Elton John and Gorillaz. A decade into his career, 6LACK joins Joel in the Artist Friendly studio to open up about how he has spent the last few years simplifying his life — cutting out excess, opportunists, and old habits — confronting the ego he didn't know he had, and learning what it actually means to build a life around what matters most.

programme.title: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls Live at House of Blues, Anaheim
programme.desc: On the third night of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim, Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls celebrate the 10th anniversary of Tape Deck Heart with a full-album performance and songs from the same era. Recorded live at the House of Blues, the show captures Turner’s raw storytelling and community-driven energy.

programme.title: There We Were, Now Here We Are... The Making of Oasis
programme.desc: This documentary commemorates the ten-year anniversary of Oasis' Definitely Maybe, learning the stories behind the songs and album recording.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel interviews Jim Adkins of Jimmy Eat World about career longevity, the creative landscape, and the 25th anniversary of Bleed American.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Italian singer, songwriter, and frontman of Måneskin, Damiano David joins Joel Madden to discuss pursuing happiness through creativity, missing home while touring, and his upcoming solo project. He reflects on defining authenticity in pop and rock, staying grounded through fame, and the evolving relationship between art, purpose, and balance.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Taylor Goldsmith, frontman of the acclaimed band Dawes, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation about balancing happiness with ambition, the search for meaning in success, and the band’s latest album, Oh Brother. programme.title: THE GREAT WAR OF ARCHIMEDES [English Dub]
programme.desc: It is the early 1930s and the command of the Japanese Imperial Navy determines to construct the world's biggest and most formidable battleship, Yamato. One of the admirals, Yamamoto Isoroku, disagrees. He recruits the upstart and mathematics' expert Tadashi Kai who discovers there are discrepancies between the official cost estimates and the actual figures. They soon find out that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy.

programme.title: First Love [English Dub]
programme.desc: One night in Tokyo, Leo, a young boxer, meets his first love, Monica, an imprisoned sex worker. Caught up in a drug-smuggling scheme, they find themselves pursued by a corrupt cop, a yakuza, his nemesis, and a female assassin.

programme.title: Bad City [English Dub]
programme.desc: In a city riddled with corruption, a secret team is put together to bring down a mobster running for mayor. Backstabbings and betrayals galore in this intense thriller.

programme.title: Sinkhole [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: After finally realizing his dream of owning a house in Seoul, Dong-won held housewarming parties and invited some of his co-workers. But his happiness is short-lived as the entire building falls to the ground. Dongwon, his co-workers Kim and Eun-joo, and a nosy neighbor, Man-soo, must make it out of a 500-meter sinkhall.

programme.title: Hard Hit [English Dub]
programme.desc: On his way to work, a bank manager receives an anonymous call claiming there's a bomb under his car seat, and if anyone exits the car, it will explode unless he can pay a ransom.

programme.title: My Way [English Dub]
programme.desc: Rivals Jun Shik and Tatsuo face captivity, separation, and reconciliation amidst colonization and war.

programme.title: Young Adult Matters [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Se-jin, a high school student, becomes pregnant and gets ostracized by her family and school. While wandering the streets, she meets Joo-yeong, an experienced runaway, and tries to get an abortion with Joo-yeong's help.

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Deok-hee needs a loan as her house and laundry have burned down. One day, she receives a call from someone claiming to be a bank manager offering her a loan. She agrees to various fees the manager asks for, but it is a voicemail scam. Deok-hee is now homeless with no help to take care of her children. Then, The so-called 'manager' contacts her again, this time pleading for his life. However, when Deok-hee seeks help from the police, they refuse to investigate, citing a lack of evidence. With no other options, Deok-hee decides to take matters into her own hands and get her money back.

programme.title: Along with the Gods : The Two Worlds [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Firefighter Ja-hong faces seven trials in the afterlife to prove his nobility in this action-packed fantasy epic.

programme.title: Along With The Gods : The Last 49 Days [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: ALONG WITH THE GODS concludes with Su-hong and his guardians facing trials, confronting their past in a final battle.

programme.title: BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the late Ming Dynasty, three sworn brothers who serve as the imperial secret police are dispatched to hunt down Wei Zhongxian, a eunuch politician who had been forced to resign from his influential post and exiled from Beijing. The brothers return successfully from their quest, only to find that their task was but the beginning of a strange conspiracy.

programme.title: BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: An imperial guard searches for the truth behind a conspiracy that framed him and his partners. The proof of his innocence lies with a wanted woman named Bei Zhai... but will she reveal what she knows? In this intense prequel to BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES, the only thing he can truly trust is his sword.

programme.title: The Villainess [English Dub]
programme.desc: An assassin seeks revenge after secrets ruin her chance at freedom, unleashing her deadly skills in a bloody rampage.

programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: Tentacle 8
programme.desc: A mysterious computer virus wipes out highly classified personnel files at the NSA, prompting a top secret investigation. Raymond Berry, an NSA operative suspected of crimes against the United States, risks his life to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Susie's Hope
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.title: Walt Before Mickey
programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live In Hamburg
programme.desc: Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Symphonic Metal Epicness
programme.desc: Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Day 1 welcomes you to Desire Mapping—an approach to living guided by how you want to feel, not just what you want to do. By shifting from goal lists to heart-centered intention, this introduction invites you to honor presence, intuition, and the feelings that shape a fulfilling life.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Desire Mapping guides you to live from the heart, focusing on how you want to feel rather than just what you want to do. Through practices like Soul Limber, appreciation, attention management, Core Desired Feelings, and exploring your inner selves, you gain clarity, agency, joy, and purpose in creating a fulfilling life.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Set down your Core Desired Feelings and explore the words that shape your inner world. This practice reveals patterns, clarifies your choices, and turns intention into living energy. Your feelings and words become a beacon, guiding you to live from the heart with focus and purpose.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Step into Intentional Creation using your Core Desired Feelings as your guide. Align actions with heart-centered intentions, release what no longer serves you, and transform your goals into sacred desires. Cultivate agency, joy, and flow as your inner world shapes your outer reality.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Integrate your Core Desired Feelings through daily practice, reflection, and heart-centered rituals. Using mindfulness, breath, and prayer, cultivate sacred connection, peace, and purpose. Return to your heart each day, and let your love and clarity ripple into the world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Having a tough time lately? Join host Lisa Garr as she speaks with beloved poet, teacher, and storyteller, Mark Nepo. Today Mark shares his insight from his latest work, “The Book of the Soul” and shares how crisis can wake us up to opportunity. Info: marknepo.com.

Info: lynnemctaggart.com.

programme.desc: Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

programme.title: Yoga For All

programme.title: Yoga For All

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. But, just as important for health and longevity is the need to rest, relax, and connect with each other. Community is essential, and being of service to one another can help you heal.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise like no other on Earth. Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

Featuring surfers of all kinds, from the neighborhood grom to some of the greatest surfers to ever live, The Essence of Surfing uncovers what it is about this awesome sport that makes it a necessary part of each of their lives. programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo le consulta a Marilda por una supuesta reconciliación con Cristóbal, después de haber escuchado una conversación entre él y Ana; ante la negación de Marilda, Guillermo encuentra una posibilidad para terminar de conquistar a Ana, porque entendió que, para Cristóbal, Ana sería segunda en su lista de amores. A pesar de ello, Cristóbal se convence que debe comprar el apartamento lindero al de su primo Guillermo, y accede a firmar los registros del préstamo bancario y así, consumar la compra, a pesar de que Ana decidió no mudarse al lado del hombre que le quita el sueño por las noches, y al que sólo lo ha visto dos veces en su vida,

programme.title: Episodio 106
programme.desc: Armando totalmente borracho le va a llevar una serenata a Briggite. Ella la recibe maravillada como siempre y cuando se van los mariachis | el se arrodilla y le dice que la ama. Finita se pone a conversar sola ya que Fabián está durmiendo la borrachera y se pone a pensar que le inventa a Armando y lo único que le viene a la cabeza es decirle que tiene una enfermedad terminal. Solymar saca a bailar a Wilker que está totalmente en otro mundo. El acepta pero pensando en Yubiri.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie le pide explicaciones a Magdalena sobre las fotos que vio en el periódico de ella con Gabriel. Magdalena insiste en que es un malentendido, pero Angie no le cree. Gabriel va a la prensa y se ocupa de armar un escándalo por esto, pidiendo que se retracten públicamente por el artículo, pero Ricardo no planea hacerlo, y contraatacar nuevamente. Más tarde, Gabriel vuelve a su casa, y Angie lo espera enfurecida. Agustín le pregunta a Sofía sobre Magdalena y Gabriel, pero ella no le dice nada. Luego, Magdalena regresa a su casa, y cuando Agustín llega se pone romántico, hasta que finalmente le pregunta sobre su relación con Gabriel. Efraín llama a Valentina para citarla, pero su esposa llega, y él disimula que arregla una reunión de trabajo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia entra a cirugía para dar a luz y sufre un paro cardíaco, pero el Dr. Orozco logra salvarla. Alejandro cumple su penitencia pidiendo perdón al barrio y confiesa su amor por Margot. Katiuska revela sus planes de casarse con Ricardo por dinero, mientras Juan Marcos intenta detenerla. María del Pilar tiene un encuentro romántico con Gustavo del que se arrepiente, a la vez que recibe un apartamento de Marcelo. Elizabeth rechaza la presencia de Katiuska en la clínica.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carmen Rosa, presionada por Alejandro y su propia conciencia, confiesa a Rosa que ella la robó a su madre verdadera Consuelo siendo una bebé y huyó a otra ciudad con Arminda. Rosa estalla en llanto sin poder asimilar que la mujer que odió toda la vida es su madre. Junior se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Marisela presiona a Adolfo para hacer abortar a Rosa. Erasto pierde movilidad en las piernas. Eustoquio continúa el plan de enloquecerlo. Rosalía intriga contra Rosa anunciando que jamás la aceptará como hermana en la familia Alamo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo está dispuesto a decirle a Carlos Ernesto quién asesinó a su hermano Miguel Ferrándiz a cambio de protección legal. Leonardo, que ahora sabe que es el padre de Mateo, no sabe si casarse con Rebeca es la decisión correcta. E Irene no quiere pedirle que la deje porque es él quien debe decidirlo. Tony lleva a Maribel a un restaurante de lujo para pedirle matrimonio, pero ella sufre un pequeño percance. Leo se pelea con su madre porque ella le prohíbe salir con María Lucía. Julio cuenta que Leo no es hijo de Leonardo.

programme.title: Episodio 106
programme.desc: Armando totalmente borracho le va a llevar una serenata a Briggite. Ella la recibe maravillada como siempre y cuando se van los mariachis | el se arrodilla y le dice que la ama. Finita se pone a conversar sola ya que Fabián está durmiendo la borrachera y se pone a pensar que le inventa a Armando y lo único que le viene a la cabeza es decirle que tiene una enfermedad terminal. Solymar saca a bailar a Wilker que está totalmente en otro mundo. El acepta pero pensando en Yubiri.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie le pide explicaciones a Magdalena sobre las fotos que vio en el periódico de ella con Gabriel. Magdalena insiste en que es un malentendido, pero Angie no le cree. Gabriel va a la prensa y se ocupa de armar un escándalo por esto, pidiendo que se retracten públicamente por el artículo, pero Ricardo no planea hacerlo, y contraatacar nuevamente. Más tarde, Gabriel vuelve a su casa, y Angie lo espera enfurecida. Agustín le pregunta a Sofía sobre Magdalena y Gabriel, pero ella no le dice nada. Luego, Magdalena regresa a su casa, y cuando Agustín llega se pone romántico, hasta que finalmente le pregunta sobre su relación con Gabriel. Efraín llama a Valentina para citarla, pero su esposa llega, y él disimula que arregla una reunión de trabajo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia entra a cirugía para dar a luz y sufre un paro cardíaco, pero el Dr. Orozco logra salvarla. Alejandro cumple su penitencia pidiendo perdón al barrio y confiesa su amor por Margot. Katiuska revela sus planes de casarse con Ricardo por dinero, mientras Juan Marcos intenta detenerla. María del Pilar tiene un encuentro romántico con Gustavo del que se arrepiente, a la vez que recibe un apartamento de Marcelo. Elizabeth rechaza la presencia de Katiuska en la clínica.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carmen Rosa, presionada por Alejandro y su propia conciencia, confiesa a Rosa que ella la robó a su madre verdadera Consuelo siendo una bebé y huyó a otra ciudad con Arminda. Rosa estalla en llanto sin poder asimilar que la mujer que odió toda la vida es su madre. Junior se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Marisela presiona a Adolfo para hacer abortar a Rosa. Erasto pierde movilidad en las piernas. Eustoquio continúa el plan de enloquecerlo. Rosalía intriga contra Rosa anunciando que jamás la aceptará como hermana en la familia Alamo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo está dispuesto a decirle a Carlos Ernesto quién asesinó a su hermano Miguel Ferrándiz a cambio de protección legal. Leonardo, que ahora sabe que es el padre de Mateo, no sabe si casarse con Rebeca es la decisión correcta. E Irene no quiere pedirle que la deje porque es él quien debe decidirlo. Tony lleva a Maribel a un restaurante de lujo para pedirle matrimonio, pero ella sufre un pequeño percance. Leo se pelea con su madre porque ella le prohíbe salir con María Lucía. Julio cuenta que Leo no es hijo de Leonardo.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo le consulta a Marilda por una supuesta reconciliación con Cristóbal, después de haber escuchado una conversación entre él y Ana; ante la negación de Marilda, Guillermo encuentra una posibilidad para terminar de conquistar a Ana, porque entendió que, para Cristóbal, Ana sería segunda en su lista de amores. A pesar de ello, Cristóbal se convence que debe comprar el apartamento lindero al de su primo Guillermo, y accede a firmar los registros del préstamo bancario y así, consumar la compra, a pesar de que Ana decidió no mudarse al lado del hombre que le quita el sueño por las noches, y al que sólo lo ha visto dos veces en su vida,

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo suspende la boda y Rebeca, enojada, le dice que el padre de Leo es Miguel. Rodrigo finalmente firma su confesión, en la que expone todo el plan de Rebeca. Así que Carlos Ernesto va con la policía a la casa de los Ferrándiz para arrestarla al igual que a Adolfo y Edgar. Pero las cosas se complican cuando Rebeca se fuga. Alejandra sigue sin tener noticias de lo que está pasando y Maribel la va a visitar. Virginia está feliz porque finalmente se sepa quién mató a Miguel. Julio no se toma bien la acusación que Carlos Ernesto le hace a su mamá.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal y su primo Guillermo conversan en la plaza, Cristóbal se muestra aún vengativo con Marilda y empeñado en no fallar en su nuevo matrimonio con Ana. Pablo visita a su hija Ana y le cuenta del Fantasma, mientras Ana a él, de Guillermo, su verdadero amor. Venancio vuelve de buscar a su hijo del colegio, en el ascensor se cruza con Pedro, este se pone nervioso y Venancio lo percibe. Carlota recibe a Venancio y su nieto; Venancio expresa sus celos por Lázara. Pedro lo está espiando, nervioso, con sus cámaras, así se entera de que vive en el edificio. Mientras Barranco y Ana conversan, llega su ex, María José, y comienzan a discutir fuerte

programme.title: Episodio 107
programme.desc: Briggite les cuenta a Ana y a Finita lo de Armando. Finita se desmaya Armando y Atanasio se encuentran y comienzan hablar de Graciela y en este momento de Briggite. Bienvenida va donde Junior y le dice que acepta trabajar en su película. Junior le entrega el guión con unas palabras que hacen llorar a Bienvenida Solymar se porta como novia de Wilker y este no dice nada. Yubiri cree esto y se va para que ellos hablen. Gisela y Juan Diego están de compras y ven a Yubiri.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Tanto Gabriel como Magdalena pelean con su pareja, porque éstos no les creen que la prensa armó una historia sobre ellos, que ellos dicen no es verdadera. Angie no se tranquiliza aún, y llama a un detective para vigilar la situación de cerca. Agustín aprovecha la escena para causarle culpa a Magdalena, mientras él la sigue engañando con Sofía. Luego, Magdalena va a una fiesta, donde tomas algunas fotos, y se encuentra con Ricardo, a quien le da una cachetada por haber escrito ese artículo sobre ella en la revista. Magdalena sale beneficiada por esto, ya que un hombre la felicita y le ofrece un trabajo en el interior del país.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia está fuera de peligro y revela su enfermedad a Ricardo, quien se desespera. Katiuska, furiosa tras ser expulsada de la clínica por Ricardo, ordena a Carrero eliminar a Celia. Mientras tanto, René se aleja definitivamente de Marcelo pese a los intentos de Graciela. Manuela perdona a Ricardo pero no olvida, enfocándose en el bienestar de Celia. Margot inicia una relación con Alejandro, y Marcelo se enfrenta violentamente a Gustavo por el amor de María del Pilar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa busca a Consuelo en la residencia y se enfrentan como madre e hija, pero el dolor del pasado pesa más que el reencuentro y Rosa marcha sin haber perdonado. Blanca llora abrazada a su nieta. Junior recobra el conocimiento y pide ver a Rosa. Erasto descubre con horror que sus piernas no responden y entra en pánico. Arminda celebra disfrutando del castigo. Adolfo enfrenta a Marisela negándose al aborto. Alejandro y Rosalía viven en tensión permanente. Isaías se ofrece a apoyar a Rosa en su pesadilla familiar. Carmen Rosa, ya sin fuerzas, pide perdón a Rosa por todo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina asesina a su hermana Rebeca para salvar a Irene y a su bebé. Luego los doctores revelan que ella sufría un trastorno de doble personalidad y que creía fervientemente que ella era en realidad su hermana muerta. Tony y Maribel terminan juntos, por comprar una nueva casa para irse a vivir juntos y formar una nueva familia. También Anzola termina casándose con Trinidad en una fiesta de casamiento a la cual toda la familia estuvo invitada. Felipe logra poner tras las rejas a Alejandra y a Rodrigo por los crímenes que cometieron. Antes de llevarlos a la prisión, deja a ella hacer su último descargo con Rodrigo en el que le confiesa que nunca lo perdonará por arruinarle la vida.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Villavicencio, Meta, una granada estalló en la casa de la familia Prieto Valencia, matando a Isis Andrea, de solo 7 años, y herido a su hermano Marco Andrés. El principal sospechoso, Carlos Efraín Sánchez, expareja violenta de Estefany Prieto, huyó tras el ataque pero fue capturado en 2011. En 2013 fue condenado a 56 años de prisión por terrorismo, homicidio agravado y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Leidy Johana García tuvo una hija con José Luis Mota, su primer novio, pero la relación terminó por problemas económicos. José Luis, incapaz de aceptar la separación de su hija, asesinó a golpes a Leidy en un ataque de ira. Fue capturado por la comunidad al intentar huir. Tras dos años y medio de juicio, fue condenado por homicidio simple a una pena mínima excarcelable y quedó en libertad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Julio Hermes formó una familia en Venadillo. Su hijo Jhon Andrés fue acusado de tener una relación incestuosa con su media hermana Angie Tatiana, quien quedó embarazada. En 2008, Angie desapareció y fue hallada muerta.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Heily García, de 23 años y madre de cuatro hijos, fue asesinada en Cali en 2017. Su amiga Mayra Alejandra Ramírez, tras perder a su propio bebé, fingió estar embarazada y asesinó a Heily para quedarse con su recién nacida, Luciana, a quien luego abandonó. La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Helmuth Ángulo lleva 21 años buscando a sus padres, Gerardo Ángulo y Carmenza Castañeda, secuestrados por el Bloque Oriental de las FARC el 19 de abril de 2000 en la vía La Calera, Cundinamarca. Con 68 años cada uno, seis hijos y dieciocho nietos, la pareja nunca alcanzó a celebrar sus bodas de oro. Su calvario ha marcado media vida de dolor e incertidumbre para la familia.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Miguel Rodríguez Moreno, hijo del excapo del Cartel de Cali Miguel Rodríguez Orejuela, escribe un libro sobre los 16 años que su padre y su tío Gilberto llevan presos en EE.UU. Ambos, ya ancianos, cumplen 30 años de condena por narcotráfico tras controlar el 80% de la cocaína exportada de Colombia. Sus familias buscan una sentencia anticipada por su delicada salud, antes de su liberación en 2029.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: ¿Es Cortney el padre de los hijos de Brittany? Según su hermana, Brittany fue infiel con su prometido Clifton. Después, Melissa afirma que su ex-marido no es el padre de sus gemelos y que es Sean! ¿Lo confirmarán los resultados del ADN?

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Un hombre, cuatro resultados de ADN, ¿es Darren el padre? Crystal y Myrissa tienen hijos de dos años y afirman que Darren es el padre; Madres y abuelas quieren descubrir la verdad sobre las dudas sobre la paternidad que atormentan a su familia.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: ¡Infieles, infieles y más infieles! El episodio de hoy de MAURY está lleno de drama, asombro y tentación. ¡Estos invitados simplemente no saben controlar sus acciones ante una tentación y se encuentran en un grave problema con sus parejas!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Monique quiere probar que Chris la atacó cuando la llevó a casa después de una fiesta. Chris niega haber hecho algo malo y dice que Monique estaba demasiado borracha como para ser consciente de lo que pasó.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Una madre casada con seis hijos dice que ha terminado con su marido y que está enamorada de un chico de 17 años; Shyaina dice que el novio de su mejor amiga le hizo insinuaciones sexuales y la manoseó a espaldas de su amiga.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: ¿Marlo tocó a su hija con Sandra cuando ella tenía 7 años? Ha evitado confrontarla durante casi 10 años, pero hoy, Sandra no se irá hasta que no se sepa la verdad y se haga justicia por su hija.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Brooklyn arroja luz sobre por qué una mujer casada contrajo una ETS; el marido de Brittany no es el único del que debería desconfiar; el novio de Brianna y su cómplice la han estado utilizando.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Las cosas iban muy bien con su nueva novia hasta que Roger se encontró en la cama con su amiga; el novio de Kandy revela un secreto que podría cambiar su generosidad; el novio de Dannisha continúa rogando por un trío.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Josh quiere recuperar a su ex, pero sus engaños resurgen; Deja confronta a su novio por su propuesta indecente a dos strippers gemelas; Misti se entera de que su novio la está engañando nuevamente.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Brady le propone matrimonio a su exnovia, pero ella se entera de que él la engañó con su amiga; Dillon siente que debe confesar que le hizo una insinuación a la amiga de su prometida.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Danny planea dejar a la madre de su hijo por una stripper; Richard le confiesa a su prometida que la engañó mientras ella estaba encerrada; Dorreon quiere poner fin a su relación.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco sigue siendo un enigma. José Manuel Gnecco, principal sospechoso, insiste en su inocencia, mientras nuevas pruebas y la controversia sobre el arma homicida complican aún más el caso.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Un productor de Séptimo Día graba cómo en un bar en Bucaramanga se alquilan niños para mendicidad. Yiriam y Franklin, migrantes venezolanos, pierden a su hija menor tras dejarla al cuidado de Franyeli, quien es detenida por mendicidad ajena. La Policía y el ICBF intervienen en varios casos similares.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Fernanda, Marleny y Jonathan son víctimas de préstamos digitales que se convierten en cobros intimidantes. Séptimo Día investiga Call Centers que usan tácticas de intimidación para cobrar deudas. Las autoridades y expertos advierten sobre los riesgos de estas aplicaciones.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los venezolanos que cometen delitos en Colombia generan un polémico debate sobre qué hacer.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Angie Sandoval perdió a su perro Alejandro, robado en Suba. La indiferencia social ante el robo fue evidente. En Colombia, el maltrato animal aumentó un 41% en el último año. La senadora Andrea Padilla busca esclarecer la ley para proteger mejor a los animales.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Casos de negligencia y posibles abusos bajo el cuidado del ICBF exponen un sistema en crisis: muertes sin esclarecer, custodias fallidas y maltrato en hogares infantiles plantean graves dudas sobre la protección real de la infancia en Colombia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ricky Cardona relata el caso en el que un intento de robo terminó en devastación.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 14 de julio de 2013, la familia Mazo fue masacrada a machete en el barrio Villa Laura, Comuna 13, Medellín. Cuatro integrantes murieron, pero un niño de 11 años sobrevivió escondido bajo una cama, convirtiéndose en testigo clave. Aunque el motivo del ataque nunca se esclareció, las pruebas presentadas por la Fiscalía permitieron identificar a los responsables del crimen.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Sandra seduce y manipula a su joven amante Gyan Carlos, convenciéndolo de asesinar a su esposo Mauricio a cambio de amor y una vida juntos. Sin saberlo, Gyan Carlos no era el único hombre bajo su control. Tras el crimen, errores de novatos facilitaron la investigación, llevando tanto a Sandra como a su amante a pagar una larga condena en prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 28 de febrero de 2016, Helen Gordillo (9) fue asesinada en Villeta. Un mes después, Israel Rodríguez, vecino de la niña, fue capturado. El crimen habría sido por venganza, tras una discusión con la abuela de Helen por una deuda.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2009, Islanis fue asesinada a los 21 años. El principal sospechoso, alias "Betún", reveló que el verdadero autor intelectual era Jonatán Pérez, un cabo del Ejército, quien la mató al enterarse de su embarazo, temiendo el impacto en su carrera militar. En 2011, Pérez fue condenado a 40 años de prisión por homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El alcalde Gentil Bahamón, elegido con récord de votos en Suaza, Huila, fue asesinado brutalmente. Su esposa, en complicidad con dos amantes, planeó el crimen para cobrar un seguro. Nueve años después, el caso aún causa indignación.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 05 de marzo del 2010, en la vereda Oro Perdido, del municipio de Cáqueza, una familia humilde y trabajadora terminan siendo víctima de un sangriento asesinato.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En Colombia, el COVID-19 deja cientos de familias rotas. Andrea Peña perdió a sus padres y hermano en pocos días; Pilar Rivera se despidió de su esposo tras 28 años juntos; y Elvis Parra perdió a sus dos padres y dos hermanos en solo 15 días. Con más de 80 mil familias en duelo, el país enfrenta un dolor colectivo mientras urge el autocuidado y el distanciamiento.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Gustavo Petró, periodista brasileño de tecnología en São Paulo, recibe diariamente entre 50 y 100 mensajes ofensivos en Twitter debido a la confusión con su homónimo, el político colombiano Gustavo Petro. Aunque le divierte la situación, también teme por su familia. Los Informantes reunió a ambos hombres para hablar sobre cómo es compartir nombre con alguien tan diferente y controvertido.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Adrian revela su secreto de infidelidad: ¿es Benjamin el padre de su hijo? Heather vuelve para otra prueba de ADN con Robert. ¿Qué dirán los resultados?

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Esa no soy yo: Anna da a luz a una niña. Dos pensamientos la atormentan: la culpa hacia su esposo y el miedo a la muerte durante el parto. Finalmente, consigue que su marido perdone a Vronski…

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima permite que Irina y Víctor se vean los fines de semana. Empieza a construir su casa, mientras Irina se involucra con un gánster. Un grupo de delincuentes incendia los establos de Sima.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima pierde a su bebé y queda estéril. Irina queda embarazada de otro hombre pero miente diciendo que es de Víctor. Sima le propone divorcio a Víctor y cae en una profunda depresión.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima convence a Irina de darle el bebé a cambio de dinero. Irina se marcha, mientras Víctor planea estudiar veterinaria. Irina, en caída libre, recurre a la brujería para vengarse de Víctor, quien es diagnosticado con leucemia.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima vende sus caballos para pagar la cirugía de Víctor en Alemania. Un adicto roba el dinero y lo entrega a un traficante. Víctor huye del hospital en busca del ladrón.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Víctor muere e Irina culpa a Sima. Irina intenta llevarse a su hija, pero Sima sigue adelante con la ayuda de la niña y de su ahijada. Vania, el hijo de Sima, regresa del ejército y se enamora de una empleada de Irina.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Vania le propone matrimonio a Larisa, pero Sima no la aprueba. Irina manipula a Vania para que reclame su parte de la granja. Sima conoce a un editor llamado Andréi en un viaje.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Andréi se enamora de Sima, pero ella lo rechaza. Vania y Larisa se mudan a la ciudad. Larisa lo abandona, dejándole a su hijo. Irina es amenazada por delincuentes por ayudar a Vania.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Vania e Irina son secuestrados por criminales. Sima y Andréi intentan rescatarlos. Irina se arrepiente de su pasado y pide perdón. Los prisioneros intentan escapar.

programme.title: Tamara
programme.desc: Tamara, guía de una galería de arte privada, es acusada de robar las joyas del renombrado coleccionista Dubrovsky. Indignado, él la busca para encararla, pero descubre que ella también es víctima de la estafa, no la villana que imaginaba. Entre ambos nace un romance. Pero el amor no será sencillo: Tamara lleva años enamorada en secreto del dueño de la galería, de cuyo favor depende su suerte, y Dubrovsky está casado con una esposa que no piensa quedarse de brazos cruzados.

Pero el amor no será sencillo: Tamara lleva años enamorada en secreto del dueño de la galería, de cuyo favor depende su suerte, y Dubrovsky está casado con una esposa que no piensa quedarse de brazos cruzados.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es la mejor opción? ¿Un refugio familiar tranquilo o un romance apasionado? ¿Una esposa, con la que ha vivido durante décadas, o una joven amante? Después de pensarlo mucho, el protagonista de la película, Alexei, de 40 años, opta por rehacer su vida...

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei confiesa su infidelidad y deja a Vera. Se casa con Marina, pero pronto conoce a otra mujer, Varvara, con quien siente una conexión profunda.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei busca a Varvara y se enamora de ella. Marina descubre su romance y le envía fotos comprometedoras, desatando una crisis.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Marina exige el divorcio. Alexei encuentra en casa de Varvara objetos de su antiguo hogar con Vera y descubre una impactante verdad.
